summary: Selects a session mode by a byte flag at this+0x113. If the flag is zero, returns 1 (single session mode) without modifying state. Otherwise OR-sets bit 2 on the flags DWORD at this+0x60 and returns 7 (multi-session mode selector).

operations.description: If byte at this+0x113 (a1+275) is zero, return 1 without modifying flags.
OR-set bit 2 on the flags DWORD at this+0x60 (a1+96) to mark multi-session mode active.
Return 7 as the multi-session mode selector.

unresolved: Owner object type for a1/this is unknown.
Meaning of the returned selector values 1 and 7 beyond the single/multi distinction is unknown.
